title: Policy document frontmatter
description: The contract every file in policies/ must satisfy. Enforced by scripts/validate.mjs.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Must equal the filename stem. Never reuse or rename — other documents point at it.

status.description: Lifecycle stage. Drives node colour in the graph.

version.description: Semver. Bump minor for substantive edits, major for changes that alter obligations.

updated.description: ISO date of the last substantive edit.

domain.description: Grouping used for graph clustering, e.g. governance, security, procurement.

tags.description: Free-form labels. Become tag nodes in the graph.

depends_on.description: Policy ids this document requires to make sense. Directed edge: this -> target.

relates_to.description: Policy ids worth reading alongside. Undirected in meaning, stored directed.

supersedes.description: Policy ids this document replaces. Targets should carry status: superseded.

references.description: External sources: laws, standards, vendor terms. Free text or URL.
